messages:
alex: quick sync — proposing a small change to routing for service-account/API key requests: prefer project-scoped key, then org default, then global fallback. and add a 5m "grace_period" for quota attribution during rollouts so we don't spam SRE alerts. PTAL
maria: short answer: love the noise reduction idea. long answer: we need to make sure billing attribution still maps to the original project when fallback happens, otherwise teams get billed unexpectedly
sam: question: during the 5m grace, do we still record usage to the backup key's quota? or do we log it separately as "attributed_but_fallback"? we need both metrics for accuracy
zhang: we can emit both. plan: router attaches an attribution header and also a "fallback" flag. telemetry will join on attribution header. header name suggestion: `x-attribution-origin: project:<proj-id>`
alex: exactly. router will preserve original origin in a header/span. example policy blob for the router:
```json
{
  "routing_preference": ["project_key","org_key","global_fallback"],
  "grace_period_seconds": 300,
  "preserve_attribution": true
}
```
maria: console/rollout UX note: we need a toggle in the rollout UI to enable grace_period per-canary and an indicator that shows "attributed vs fallback" side-by-side. PMs will want explicit panels before flip
carol: ops ask: can we get an alert when fallback rate > 1% for 10m and have the alert include the SA owner contact? else oncall ends up chasing ghosts
ops-bot: created alert: FallbackRateHigh -> pd:eng-platform (threshold: >1% over 10m). routing team: please confirm owner labels on SA resources
sam: also a perf note: if project-scoped keys are routed to smaller GPU pools, fallback spikes will create cache + pool-warmup latency spikes. telemetry should include per-route p50/p95 and backend pool id
raj: also consider token-binding TTL implications. if we do short-lived impersonation tokens during fallback, we'll see higher token churn and attribution noise. recommend keeping TTLs sane or track churn metric
zhang: I'll open a PR to the router: add `x-attribution-origin`, `x-routing-fallback` flags, and wire trace tags. will add feature flag gating the grace period behavior
alex: great. who picks up dashboards/alerts?
maria: I'll own dashboards. plan: create panels for attributed_tokens, fallback_count, fallback_rate, grace_window_heatmap, and a timeline that overlays canary rollouts
zhang: I'll own router change + PR. will coordinate with sam for latency tests
alex: timeline: prototype + internal demo this week, canary next week. scheduling question: canary window needs to align with billing batch windows (end of day) —ops?
carol: added a short blurb to the rollout playbook and noted billing window caveat
ops-bot: note: please ensure SA owner labels exist on all project keys before canary
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2024-06-12T22:00Z by zhang
alex: thanks all. follow-ups: zhang (router PR), maria (dashboards), sam (latency test), carol (playbook blurb). will sync Fri morning if anything blocks :thumbsup:
